definitions.explanation: Deep affection or favoritism shown by someone in a position of power or authority toward a particular person. Often implies a special, exclusive fondness that goes beyond ordinary affection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{王|おう}→王：19353_ou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い⟦{妃|きさき}→妃：14750_kisaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{寵愛|ちょうあい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The king doted on his young queen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{殿様|とのさま}→殿様：10455_tonosama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寵愛|ちょうあい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{家臣|かしん}→家臣：12655_kashin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出世|しゅっせ}→出世：08359_shusse⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}かった→早い：00514_hayai⟧。
examples.english: The retainer who received the lord's favor was promoted quickly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{父親|ちちおや}→父親：03469_chichioya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{寵愛|ちょうあい}⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦わがまま→わがまま：03789_wagamama⟧な⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Because she was doted on by her father growing up, she has a spoiled side.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary word with historical associations. Originally described the favor of rulers, nobles, or other powerful figures toward particular subordinates or consorts. In modern usage, it can describe any strong favoritism or doting, though it retains a somewhat elevated tone. Can be used as a noun ({寵愛|ちょうあい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧) or as a suru verb ({寵愛|ちょうあい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寵愛|ちょうあい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive favor
- {寵愛|ちょうあい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dote on, to favor
- {寵愛|ちょうあい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一身|いっしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: to monopolize someone's affection
